data.name: Hana
data.gender_notes: Hana is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ه-ن-أ (h-n-ʾ), 'to be happy, to enjoy'. Hanāʾ means 'happiness, bliss'. Its root is ه-ن-أ (h-n-ʾ). A common Arabic female name. Hana is a Arabic name meaning “Happiness; bliss”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hana expresses “Happiness; bliss”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ه-ن-أ (h-n-ʾ), 'to be happy, to enjoy'. Hanāʾ means 'happiness, bliss'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hana total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
